desc: Lancer angel: pale lavender and white tattered cloak with gold trim, three stacked layers of white and gold feathered wings on each side, holds a long gold spear. Glowing gold eyes. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big hooded head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px dark outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Hood interior is a solid black void with only two small glowing eyes.
